service_targets.measured_by: the independent monitor: a free hosted uptime checker, separate from the hosts, checking every few minutes

chain.rule: a block committed in the minute

endpoints.rule: at least one client endpoint serves state within max_head_lag_blocks of the head

on_call.response: best effort, no fixed response time
on_call.alerts: the independent monitor pushes alerts to the founder's phone through a free notification service

chain_history.offline_export: monthly, to the founder's own drive

backup.snapshots: the approved daily snapshots (E05 snapshot_interval_blocks, snapshot_keep)
backup.keys: only in the founder's key kits, never in routine backups
backup.signing_state: never restored from a backup; a replacement signs only after the old host is fenced off

recovery.endpoint_rto_basis: one endpoint, rebuilt from the published files and state sync like a sentry
